name: XJ Electric Co., Ltd.
summary: XJ Electric Co., Ltd. provides energy and power and technology equipment in China and internationally. It offers DC transmission products and services, including DC transmission converter valves, DC flow measurement equipment, DC transmission control and protection systems, DC simulation systems, digital converter stations, and converter valve cooling equipment, as well as prefabricated substation.
